articles.title: New York sues Polymarket, alleging it is running an illegal gambling operation
articles.snippet: The state wants to block Polymarket from operating without a gambling license and recover allegedly illegal gains.

articles.title: Researchers propose Zcash-style private Bitcoin transfers without a soft fork
articles.snippet: Shielded Bitcoin would use zero-knowledge proofs and encrypted notes to hide transaction details without changing Bitcoin consensus, but researchers have raised questions about anonymity and quantum resistance.

articles.title: OpenAI Is Building a $500 per Month ChatGPT Pro Max Plan, Leaks Suggest
articles.snippet: Leaked code strings and screenshots point to a new tier that would cost 25 times more than ChatGPT Plus, aimed at people who need the bot to work faster, not just longer.

articles.title: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth Holds Bitcoin in a Coinbase Wallet, Filing Shows
articles.snippet: Two entries in his annual disclosure put the holding somewhere between $16,000 and $65,000, alongside more than $1 million in cash.

articles.title: Federal Reserve Unveils Stablecoin Rules on Reserves and Capital
articles.snippet: The central bank opened two proposals for comment under the GENIUS Act, requiring issuers it supervises to back tokens fully with safe assets and creating an application process for banks seeking to issue stablecoins.
